resources.string: Lets an RWKV model schedule the presets set to RWKV-Instant or RWKV-Curve in deck options. Needs imported model files and enough memory.
Not available: this phone has too little memory for this model and your collection. Scheduling is unchanged. Under RWKV model files → Download you can allow the model anyway.
Not available: import an RWKV two-head model first. Scheduling is unchanged.
Not available: the RWKV engine could not load the model files. Scheduling is unchanged.
On: RWKV schedules the presets set to RWKV in deck options.

AnkiQuest ships no RWKV weights: they have no licence for redistribution and are for personal and research use only (WEIGHTS-NOTICE.md of the %1$s release of JSchoreels/anki-rwkv). Download lists every model of that release on GitHub with the memory it needs for your collection, and fetches the one you pick. Or download the zips yourself and choose them or their weights.f32.bin files. Only files whose SHA-256 matches a known model are kept.
Not downloaded: no connection to GitHub.
Not downloaded: the file does not match the known RWKV model.
The most accurate model that fits this phone: LogLoss %1$s in the release\'s evaluation, lower is better.
